2. Enter your zID and password, then click Connect & scan.
3. Review the list, deselect anything you want to keep, then click Clean selected.

Only old remote servers, explicitly obsolete extensions, installer caches,
and old logs are eligible. Current/latest servers, coursework, downloads,
and editing history are preserved. Recently changed or uncertain items are skipped.

Passwords are not saved. Selected files are removed directly;
development components can be reinstalled.
CSE home directories are shared across machines: close remote VS Code
connections from your other computers too.
This app does not clean on a schedule or stop your work processes.
